description.value:
Rot is the half of the cycle people pretend they're not standing in. Blightline Wardens do the work nobody thanks them for: collapsing a structure before it falls on its own, killing a bloom before it reaches a water table, hollowing out the thing that cannot be fought head-on.

While the needle is on Grey, your poison and acid damage ignores 5 points of resistance, and objects and structures you damage lose Hardness equal to how far out on Grey the needle currently sits.

7th — Nothing Wasted: when a creature dies within 30 feet of you, move the needle one step toward Grey without casting.
15th — What's Underneath: once per day, reduce a non-magical structure of any size to rubble over one minute.

cinderfall.incomplete: The subclass-*selection* wiring (`ChoiceSet`/`GrantItem`, `otherTags: ["seed-warden-cutting"]`) is already correctly implemented on `seed-warden.cutting.json` — verified: `greenline.json:28` carries the matching `otherTags`, so no changes needed there. This card's own passive content (ignore-resistance magnitude, Hardness-loss magnitude tied to "how far out") is `BLOOMROT-NULL`-blocked: no flag exists for "on Grey" or its magnitude. The 7th (move needle without casting) and 15th (once/day structure demolition) sub-features are also `BLOOMROT-NULL`/frequency-gated (bucket 3).
